title: Raise conditional kappa to 0.00310432 with composed helper splits
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This construction gives complete conditional **κ = 0.00310432**. It improves the consumed [PR5601](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5601) claim by **0.00001837** and the released [PR5608](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5608) claim by **0.00000248**. It is **2.5446% above** selected 0.003027288235; the selected record is unchanged.

[Proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/PROOF.md) · [Boundary relations](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/BOUNDARIES.json) · [Independent cuts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SPLITS.json) · [Preparation sites](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/PREPARATION.json) · [Complete receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/RESULT.json) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/SOURCES.json) · [Validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/VALIDATION.md).

At a common-frame cut, a pure helper input functional and pure helper output direction have unit pairing. Explicit scalar input, cut and output bases let one independent target finish early and a fresh independent input use the suffix. Both complete boundary supports are checked. The new construction uses nine such splits and composes the released improvements as follows:

- PR5605's shared relay has eight exact source edits disjoint from PR5601's 21 edits against their common PR5580 word. Full input preconditioning and late cleanup remain.
- Five fixed PR5602 boundary relations each remove one paid H5 and replace one H9 target by H4. The sixth published relation uses a removed contact and is omitted.
- Nine independent splits add targets without added Gaussian calls.
- PR5606's two exact preparation identities hold on the new word. Two H1 queries are removed, the H2 target is debited, and every new owned lifetime is charged.

| Complete quantity | Result |
| --- | ---: |
| Local independent inputs / helpers | 743 / 535 |
| Owned roles / lifetimes / peak | 9 / 11 / 2 |
| Paid calls | 66,546 |
| Productive fields | 12,958 |
| Rank-mass surplus | 760 |
| Tested saving | 0.0031043205 |
| Exact raw crossing | (0.00310432143397, 0.00310432143398) |

The p16/a7 caller charges every helper normalizer, main adapter, scalar operation, route, COPY/CLEAR path, thin query and whole idle. The target debit and peak owned occupancy two enter the full bill. Tail decay is 39/40 and compiler logarithm power is 1024. Two exact moment engines, all compiler conditions and 54 strict plus four functional outer conditions pass. The complete nonrecursive allowance is 184647552, below 1e9.

A rational negative derivative bound gives the unique raw crossing for this fixed invoice on [0,0.0034]. The final finite screen finds no further tested split in 46 boundary groups. Neither result is a global optimum. The five framework assumptions and helper-endpoint contract remain. The huge uniform word and complete rounded multiplier are not materialized. Independent scientific acceptance is pending.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority 7. Task: `complex-new-helper-inventory`, scope **changed** at the donor's request for a different mechanism and a complete kappa gain. The input count and target contract change; a complete caller replaces the historical frozen-provider screen. [TASK.json](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674/research/p104-helper-subspace-splits/TASK.json) preserves the original card and scope reason.

[Canonical coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19183208) records the claims and releases. The [parallel PR5602 claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154639) was released before its fixed relations were composed. The later relay and preparation checks consume published constructions; they do not extend those authors' searches. The shared rank-one mechanism is credited without exclusive discovery claims. Every combined interface and invoice is replayed; headline gains are not added.

The consumed PR5601 head is `8f7e870b22885a367b347dc12791da98fd53f83d`; PR5602 is `6c224aa720203c4f4615e6538d8038a275387db8`; PR5605 is `4a57d245ac3918ccc9947a867ece24573605e243`; PR5606 is `cd7d89345c6c5d2114625e5ce912a52ecd5e1d27`. Retained copies and older PR5565/PR5580 sources are pinned to ancestors of this branch. The unchanged source bytes and attribution are explicit in the manifest.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-helper-subspace-splits
```

The direct isolated complete replay passes at `baf2921bede71664d201e055e5ba34fe5f979674`. It checks every intermediate interface, 565,504 transpose coefficients, 2,916 exact native maps, the physical caller, two moment engines, compiler conditions and all 58 outer predicates. Seventeen live inputs are authenticated before imports. Eleven local/controller mutation controls and retained native/price controls reject. Metadata, committed bytes and export integrity pass. The final registered normal/optimized repeat is running; a fresh read-only Git-free replay follows. These pending checks are not yet claimed for this revision.

Full-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; all six source-pin commits are verified branch ancestors. Registered replay needs no cached unmerged-branch objects. Hosted CI and independent scientific review are separate from these author-side checks.
